description: This file implements a minimal example of a Git filter protocol version 2 in Perl. It handles communication with Git via packet-based protocol operations, performing as either a clean or smudge filter, with basic packet read/write functions and flow control for handling command and data processing.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, interprets the packet size, and returns a status indicator along with the packet content.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text line packet from STDIN, ensuring it is properly terminated with LF.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT, prefixed with its length.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text line packet to STDOUT with proper framing.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Sends a flush signal (0 length) to STDOUT.
